trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in GTA 6 to unlock this platinum. Focus on story missions, collectibles, and side activities to achieve 100% completion.
steps: Complete all main story missions.
Collect every hidden collectible.
Finish all side missions and activities.
Earn all gold medals on missions.
Unlock every other trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the Gone Fishing mission to unlock this trophy. Progress through the mission objectives until completion.
steps: Start Gone Fishing mission
Follow mission objectives
Complete all required tasks

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Progress through the opening chapter of GTA 6's story campaign by completing all mandatory missions. The trophy unlocks automatically upon reaching the end of Chapter 1's final mission.
steps: Start a new game and follow the opening cutscenes
Complete each story mission marked with a yellow icon
Finish the final mission of Chapter 1

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: This story trophy unlocks automatically upon finishing all missions in Chapter 2 of the main campaign. Simply progress through the narrative until the chapter concludes.
steps: Start or continue the main story campaign
Complete all Chapter 2 missions in order
Watch the chapter completion cutscene

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the main story campaign to unlock this trophy. Progress through the narrative missions until the chapter concludes naturally.
steps: Start or continue the main story campaign
Complete all Chapter 3 story missions
Watch the chapter ending cutscene
Trophy unlocks automatically upon completion

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks automatically upon finishing Chapter 4 of the main campaign. Progress through the story missions until the chapter concludes.
steps: Continue main story missions
Complete all Chapter 4 objectives
Watch chapter ending cutscene

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy unlocks automatically upon completing the final story mission of GTA 6. No special preparation is needed beyond reaching the narrative conclusion.
steps: Progress through all main story chapters
Complete the final mission objective
Watch the ending credits sequence

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission that appears early in the main story. Finish all objectives without failing to unlock the trophy.
steps: Start the Breakfast Run mission from the map.
Follow the waypoint to the diner.
Deliver the food to the target.
Return to the safehouse to finish.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks automatically upon finishing the Cartel Heist mission during the main campaign. Progress through the story until this heist becomes available, then complete all its objectives.
steps: Advance the main story to unlock the Cartel Heist
Prepare weapons, armor, and a fast getaway vehicle
Complete all heist setup and finale objectives
Watch the mission completion cutscene

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' mission during the main story campaign. This mission becomes available as you progress through the narrative and cannot be missed if you follow the story.
steps: Progress through main story missions
Reach the 'Child's Play' mission
Complete all mission objectives
Watch the mission completion cutscene
Trophy unlocks automatically

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in the Headliners strand to unlock this trophy. Progress through each mission sequentially as they become available.
steps: Start the Headliners mission series
Complete each mission objective
Finish the final Headliners mission

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks after finishing the VCIA Takedown story mission. Progress through the main campaign until this operation becomes available.
steps: Advance main story missions
Reach VCIA Takedown operation
Complete all mission objectives

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission Operation Savage Glory to earn the trophy. Progress through the story until the mission appears, then complete all objectives.
steps: Reach the mission marker on the map.
Follow the on-screen objectives during the mission.
Defeat all enemies and complete the final objective.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion by finishing all story missions, side content, collectibles, and activities. Track progress via the in-game checklist and clean up any remaining tasks in post-game.
steps: Complete all main story missions
Finish all Strangers and Freaks missions
Collect every hidden collectible
Complete all side activities and mini-games
Verify 100% stats in pause menu

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: This trophy requires performing 250 stunt jumps across the map using vehicles. Progress accumulates naturally during exploration and can be finished in post-game cleanup.
steps: Find stunt ramp locations on the map
Use fast vehicles like motorcycles or sports cars
Hit each ramp at sufficient speed to trigger the stunt cinematic
Track progress in the stats menu under stunt jumps completed
Replay missed jumps via map markers until counter reaches 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Complete one instance of every distinct activity type scattered across Vice City. Activities include races, sports, mini-games, and side hustles marked on the map.
steps: Open map and filter for activity icons
Complete one race event
Play one sport or mini-game
Finish one side hustle mission
Check trophy progress in menu

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit every shooting range across the map and complete each challenge with a gold medal score. Practice each weapon type to master the required accuracy and speed thresholds.
steps: Locate all shooting ranges on the map
Complete each challenge with gold medal
Practice weapon handling for better accuracy
Replay challenges to improve scores

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Complete every Top Fun Drone Race location across the map to earn this trophy. Each race is a repeatable side activity marked on the map.
steps: Open map and filter for Top Fun Drone Race icons
Travel to each location and start the race
Win first place at every unique location

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races across the map. Replay any race type until the counter reaches 20.
steps: Open race menu from map
Select 20 unique race events
Finish first in each race
Track progress in trophies menu
Repeat any missed races

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing competition at any available pier or waterfront location. Win by catching larger or more valuable fish within the time limit to unlock this trophy.
steps: Find Cal near a fishing spot
Accept his fishing challenge
Catch bigger fish than Cal
Complete the challenge to win

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any arcade cabinet in the game world and play a mini-game to completion. These retro diversions are scattered across bars, arcades, and safehouses for easy access.
steps: Locate an arcade cabinet in any bar
Interact with the machine to start playing
Finish the mini-game to unlock trophy

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's concluding story mission when it becomes available during the campaign. The mission unlocks naturally as you progress through his mission strand.
steps: Advance the main story until Andy's final mission appears
Accept the mission from Andy's contact point
Complete all mission objectives to finish his storyline

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks by finishing Kenton's last storyline mission. Progress through his mission chain until the final one appears and complete it.
steps: Meet Kenton to start his mission line
Complete all preceding Kenton missions
Finish the final Kenton mission
Trophy unlocks after mission completion

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's concluding story mission as it unlocks naturally through the campaign. No special preparation is needed beyond reaching that narrative point.
steps: Progress through Billy's mission line
Accept his final mission marker
Complete all mission objectives

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight distinct stranger mission threads scattered throughout Leonida's map. Each strand involves multiple encounters with the same NPC that unlock progressively.
steps: Explore Leonida to discover stranger mission markers
Complete all encounters for each individual NPC
Track progress via the mission log menu
Finish eight full strands to unlock trophy

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand by finishing his last assignment. This bronze trophy unlocks automatically when the final mission in his storyline concludes.
steps: Progress through Randy's mission chain
Accept his final mission when available
Complete all objectives to finish

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last storyline mission to unlock the trophy. Ensure you complete all preceding tasks for him first.
steps: Start Tyrone's mission chain from his contact.
Complete each preceding mission in order.
Play and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This trophy requires finding and meditating at all designated meditation locations scattered throughout Leonida's open world. Use the in-game map or online collectible guides to track each spot and complete the meditation interaction at every one.
steps: Open map and locate all meditation spot icons
Travel to each marked location across Leonida
Interact to meditate at every spot
Confirm trophy unlocks after last meditation

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting request by tracking and taking down a unique animal in the wilderness. Use your hunting skills and appropriate weapons to secure the trophy kill.
steps: Find Bret's hunting mission marker on the map
Track the unique animal using Eagle Eye or signs
Kill the animal cleanly with a suitable weapon
Return to Bret to complete the mission
trophies.missable_reason: Unique animal hunt may be a one-time side mission that disappears after story progression

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect three full sets of collectible cards scattered across Vice City. Each set requires finding multiple individual cards hidden in the open world.
steps: Explore Vice City to locate card collectibles
Pick up cards to progress set completion
Complete three full sets to unlock trophy

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: This trophy requires using the in-game WAiNK social media app to post content at 100 distinct map locations. Progress tracks automatically across both protagonists' playthroughs and free roam.
steps: Unlock WAiNK app via story progression
Travel to undiscovered map regions
Select WAiNK It at each location
Repeat until counter reaches 100

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: This trophy requires completing 50 in-game challenges across various categories like weapons, vehicles, and exploration. Progress tracks automatically, so focus on diverse activities to unlock it naturally.
steps: Open challenges menu to view available categories
Complete daily and weekly challenges first
Focus on combat, driving, and exploration tasks
Track progress in pause menu statistics
Repeat until 50 total challenges finished

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a four-star wanted level while accompanied by your story partner, then evade pursuit until the wanted meter clears. The co-op dynamic means both characters must survive the escape together.
steps: Trigger 4-star wanted level with partner
Find vehicle or cover to lose sightlines
Stay out of radar cones until stars vanish

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: This trophy requires coordinating three consecutive store robberies with your partner while maintaining a clean wanted level throughout. Prepare fast vehicles and suppressed weapons to quickly hit targets and evade police between robberies.
steps: Equip suppressed weapons and fast getaway vehicle
Rob first store with partner present
Evade police quickly before next robbery
Repeat for two more stores consecutively
Maintain zero wanted level throughout chain
trophies.missable_reason: Requires specific multi-store robbery chain without wanted level

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: This trophy requires finding and entering 100 different vehicles across Vice City. Use the in-game vehicle tracking system to monitor progress and prioritize rare spawns.
steps: Enter any 100 unique vehicle models
Check progress in the pause menu stats
Target rare spawns like helicopters and boats
Switch characters to access different vehicle pools
Revisit areas at different times for variety

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus during a firefight and eliminate five foes before the effect ends. Stock up on ammo and find a dense enemy encounter to maximize your chances.
steps: Enter Combat Focus ability during combat.
Target and shoot five enemies quickly.
Ensure all five die before focus expires.
Retry if needed; ability recharges over time.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off without authorization. This can be done during free roam by entering any plane or helicopter on the tarmac and flying away.
steps: Travel to VCIA airport in Vice City
Enter any parked aircraft on the runway
Take off and fly away from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Earn this trophy by commandeering a Rhino tank and surviving intense heat while causing chaos. Use the vehicle's firepower to maintain a high wanted level until the requirement is met.
steps: Obtain a Rhino tank via cheat or mission
Raise your wanted level to maximum
Stay alive in the tank for the required duration

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete a jewelry store robbery using stealth to avoid detection entirely. Use suppressed weapons, stay out of sight lines, and hack alarms before they trigger.
steps: Enter jewelry store during quiet hours
Equip suppressed weapon and stealth outfit
Disable alarm system before grabbing loot
Exit without alerting guards or cameras
Deliver stolen goods to fence

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete five bank vault heists by infiltrating the vault, securing the loot, and successfully evading law enforcement. Each robbery requires careful planning, the right crew, and a clean getaway vehicle.
steps: Locate bank vault locations across the map
Recruit skilled crew members for each heist
Execute the vault breach and grab the cash
Escape the wanted level using getaway routes
Repeat for five separate bank vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hijack an armored truck during its random patrol and lose the resulting wanted level. These trucks appear spontaneously on roads, so drive highways until one spawns, then steal it and escape the police.
steps: Patrol highways until armored truck appears
Stop truck and eliminate guards
Enter truck and drive away
Lose wanted level to complete

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal the entire Leonida map by visiting every named region and location. Use vehicles and aircraft to efficiently cover ground and uncover all fogged areas.
steps: Complete main missions to unlock map regions
Fly across the map in a helicopter
Drive to remaining undiscovered locations
Check map for fogged areas
Visit all named neighborhoods and wilderness

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Locate and rob illegal operations run by every gang in Vice City. Complete each gang's operation to unlock the trophy.
steps: Open map and find illegal operation markers
Approach each gang's operation site
Complete the robbery objective
Repeat for all remaining gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean Beach during the story or free roam to find a beachside bar. Order a cocktail and enjoy the view to unlock this trophy.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach area
Locate a beachfront bar or vendor
Purchase and consume a cocktail
Wait for trophy notification

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission where you escape a vehicle showroom by smashing through the exit. This references the classic Vice City mission of the same name.
steps: Reach the vehicle showroom mission in the story
Steal a vehicle from the showroom floor
Smash through the glass exit to escape
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a game with a successful follow‑through. The alley unlocks early, so you can earn this anytime during free roam.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a bowling match from the menu.
Score a strike using follow‑through technique.
Finish the game to unlock trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Complete the partnership mission that unlocks through natural story progression. This trophy triggers automatically when you finish the required collaborative objective with your story partner.
steps: Progress through main story missions
Reach the partnership mission chapter
Complete all partnership objectives
Watch the completion cutscene

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks when you make a pivotal narrative decision during the main campaign. The choice occurs at a specific story juncture and cannot be revisited once passed.
steps: Progress through main story missions
Reach the critical decision point
Select your preferred narrative outcome
Confirm choice to unlock trophy
trophies.missable_reason: One-time story choice that cannot be replayed without restarting

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks when you successfully complete a failed mission or activity on your second attempt. Simply retry the objective after failing once to earn it.
steps: Fail a mission or activity intentionally
Select retry from the mission menu
Complete the objective on the second try

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks when you experience a bizarre, unexplained event during the main story. Trigger the encounter by exploring the map at night and investigating unusual phenomena.
steps: Play through main story missions
Explore wilderness areas at night
Investigate strange lights or sounds
Complete the resulting encounter

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down multiple enemies in one motion by performing a melee attack while driving past them on a motorcycle. This stunt counts in free roam and requires lining up a group of pedestrians or hostiles.
steps: Grab a motorcycle and build moderate speed
Target a cluster of 3+ NPCs on foot
Press melee attack while driving past them

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: This trophy requires accumulating $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your criminal contacts. Focus on completing laundering jobs regularly to reach the total efficiently.
steps: Acquire Marked Bills from missions or activities
Visit contact to launder bills
Repeat until $250,000 total laundered
Track progress in stats menu

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: This trophy requires accumulating $100,000 in total purchases across all in-game shops. Money carries between characters, so spend freely on weapons, clothes, vehicles, and services to reach the threshold naturally.
steps: Earn money through missions and activities
Visit various shops across the map
Purchase items until cumulative spending hits $100,000
Track progress in stats menu

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available across the map to unlock this trophy. Check the Dynasty 8 website or visit each location directly to complete all purchases.
steps: Open Dynasty 8 website on phone
Browse garage listings for available properties
Purchase each garage one by one
Confirm all garages show as owned

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten different vehicles using the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. You can do this anytime while exploring Vice City.
steps: Open phone and launch Scooter Bros app
Approach any drivable vehicle and select register
Repeat with nine more unique vehicles
Trophy unlocks after tenth registration
